label: ScoMcrA system
definition: A type IV modification-dependent restriction system in which an organism possesses a ScoMcrA-family locus encoding a sulfur-binding-domain phosphorothioated-DNA restriction endonuclease.
observations: ScoMcrA branch under type IV modification-dependent restriction system; distinct from the broader McrA family, EcoKMcrA, McrBC, GmrSD, MspJI, PvuRts1I, TagI, VcaM4I, broad RM_Type_IV and Other_Type_IV source keys, individual ScoMcrA proteins, individual SBD domains, individual mcrA genes, ScoMcrA nuclease activity outside a complete organism-level Type IV restriction system, individual phosphorothioated DNA substrates, and the DefenseFinder ScoMcrA source key outside a complete organism-level system.
